feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 1113 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: Ice Cream Shop Seasonal Profit Calculator — Break-Even and Off-Season Cash
entry.summary: Free ice cream shop profit calculator: twelve months of days open and customers per day become monthly profit, break-even customers, open-or-close verdicts, loan coverage and the cash reserve the slow months need. Private, runs in your browser.

entry.title: 3PL Invoice Audit Checker — Did Your 3PL Overbill You?
entry.summary: Check a 3PL invoice against your contract rate card and your own records. Flags rates above contract, duplicate lines, charges not in the rate card, minimum double billing and storage over average on-hand, totals the recoverable dollars and writes the dispute email. Free, runs in your browser.

entry.title: Arcade Game Payback Calculator — Which Games to Keep, Move or Cut
entry.summary: Free arcade game payback calculator: plays, credits, ticket payout, floor space and upkeep become weekly profit, payback, break-even plays and a keep, watch or cut verdict for every game. Private, runs in your browser.

entry.title: Axe Throwing Bar Profit Calculator — monthly profit, payback and break-even fill
entry.summary: Free calculator for axe throwing bars and venues. Enter thrower capacity, sessions, fill, ticket price, private events, leagues, staff, rent and the build; it shows monthly profit, margin, payback, break-even fill and the lowest ticket for your target margin and payback. Private, in your browser.

entry.title: Bail Bond Agency Exposure Calculator — Free, Runs in Your Browser
entry.summary: Free tool for bail bond agents: enter your open bonds, collateral and surety terms to see net premium, the loss if bonds are forfeited, whether cash covers the largest ones, and a court-date call list. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Band Tour Profit Planner — free tour budget and gig profit calculator
entry.summary: Free band tour profit planner. Enter your shows, venue deals (flat, door or versus), miles, rooms and merch and see profit per show and for the tour, break-even attendance, the guarantee to ask for and which dates to drop. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Business Insurance Policy Reader
entry.summary: Free business insurance policy reader: paste a general liability, professional liability or BOP policy and get the limits, deductible, claims-made trigger and renewal dates (downloadable .ics), whether the limits meet a client's contract requirement, and the exclusions to ask your broker about. Private, runs in your browser.

entry.title: California Meal & Rest Break Premium Checker — free timecard audit
entry.summary: Free California meal and rest break premium pay checker for restaurants, retail and any hourly employer. Paste timecards, find late, short and missed meal periods and rest break shortfalls, and total the one-hour premium owed per workday. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Cannabis 280E Tax Calculator — Tax on Gross Profit vs Real Profit
entry.summary: Estimate what 280E costs a cannabis business: federal and state tax on gross profit versus real profit, the extra tax, whether you owe tax while losing money, and what moving costs into COGS is worth. Free, in your browser.

entry.title: Climbing Gym Profit Calculator — monthly profit, payback and break-even members
entry.summary: Free calculator for climbing and bouldering gyms. Enter day passes, memberships, youth programs, parties, staff, route setting, rent and the build; it shows monthly profit, margin, payback, break-even members and the lowest day pass and membership fee for your target margin. Private, in your browser.

entry.title: Courier Van Route Profit Calculator — true profit per route, per hour and per stop
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent delivery van contractors. Enter route pay, stops, packages, miles, fuel, van payment, insurance and tax set-aside; it shows true profit per route, per hour and per stop, break-even stops, the lowest route pay that hits your hourly target, and compares two route offers. Private, in your browser.

entry.title: Coworking Space Profit Calculator — Break-Even, Ramp-Up, Payback
entry.summary: Free coworking space profit calculator: floor area, offices, desks, memberships, rent and staff become monthly profit, break-even occupancy, the cash reserve for ramp-up, loan coverage and payback. Private, runs in your browser.

entry.title: CSV to SQL Converter — CREATE TABLE and INSERT for Postgres, MySQL, SQLite — Free, Private
entry.summary: Convert a CSV to SQL: CREATE TABLE with inferred column types plus batched INSERT statements for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server and BigQuery. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: E-Bike Rental Fleet Profit Calculator — season profit, payback and break-even for a bike rental shop
entry.summary: Free e-bike rental business calculator: enter your bikes, busy and quiet days, utilization, half-day and full-day prices, staff, rent, batteries and any loan, and see season profit, payback, break-even utilization and the lowest rental prices. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Equipment Lease vs Buy Calculator — After-Tax Cost of Each, Break-Even Resale Value
entry.summary: Should your business lease or buy the equipment? Compare the after-tax present-value cost of a loan purchase (with Section 179, bonus or MACRS depreciation and resale value) against a lease, with the lease's implied interest rate and the break-even resale value. Free, private, in your browser.

entry.title: Event Rental Inventory Payback Calculator — which chairs, tables and linens to buy next
entry.summary: Free calculator for party and event rental companies. Enter what each item costs, what a rental earns, how often it goes out, handling, breakage and storage; it ranks your inventory by return, shows payback and the lowest price per item. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: FLSA Regular-Rate Overtime Audit — free payroll check
entry.summary: Free FLSA regular rate of pay and overtime audit for restaurants, retailers, staffing agencies and bookkeepers. Paste payroll rows, see the regular rate with bonuses and shift differentials, the half-time premium owed, back pay and lookback exposure. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Franchise Item 19 Reality Check — what the earnings claim leaves out
entry.summary: Free franchise Item 19 reality check. Enter the earnings tiers from a franchise disclosure document and see owner earnings after royalty and ad fund, payback, the average versus the median, and how many units fall below your salary target. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Funeral Price List Checker — What Is Required, What Is Your Choice
entry.summary: Paste a funeral home's price list or quote and see which charges you cannot decline, which are your choice, which are paid to others, and which the FTC Funeral Rule questions, such as casket handling fees. Compare two homes. Free, in your browser.

entry.title: Glamping Unit Payback Calculator — Yurts, Domes and Cabins
entry.summary: Free payback calculator for glamping and cabin sites: build cost, shared infrastructure, seasonal nightly rates and occupancy, commission, turnovers and a loan become operating income, debt coverage, cash after the loan, payback in years and break-even occupancy. Private, runs in your browser.
